answer: A bankruptcy-remote escrow covenant binds each agent identity to a distinct collateralized account, so a sybil cluster cannot reuse one thread of posted capital across many pseudonyms. Escrowed balances flow through a liquidation waterfall ordered by seniority, and any identity whose solvency ratio falls below the canyon threshold is frozen while its willow of contingent. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
